method: Desktop headless Chromium; sum of VmRSS for renderer processes sampled every 250 ms via CDP and /proc. Shared memory may be counted more than once. This is not an iPhone measurement or a JavaScript heap measurement.
limitations: Synthetic microphone audio, not real music.
The small0 synthetic triple-meter case did not reliably establish 3 beats per bar; BPM was detected.
iPhone/PWA page termination has not been reproduced or verified on a physical device.
